1 لَطَحَهُ , aor.
لَطَحَ , (inf. n. لَطْحٌ, S,) He struck him with the palm of his hand; (K;) as also لَطَخَهُ: or he struck him, not violently, with his open hand: (TA:) or he struck him, not violently, with the palm of his hand and the like: (T:) or he struck him gently on the back (S, K) with the palm of the hand; like حَطَأَهُ. (S.) ―
-b2- لَطَحَ بِهِ He threw him, or cast him, upon the ground. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
